scope: Open the first Topo iteration including seeded-color validation
tolerance_reason: All integer fields are exact except nondeterministic Topo picks. Each such pick must have a legal first-free witness from immutable neighbors and before/after values of concurrently changing neighbors; fixed colors and every other field remain exact.
preconditions: Complete cumulative adjacency with explicit static-group metadata; valid active link bodies/groups, zero-length gaps premarked inert for Topo steps
Topo input palette is 0 through 63; pending values are valid colors or MAX; fixtures do not exhaust the palette
Reset grids cover all slots; scalar flags use one thread; finite bounded u32 counters and no overflowing addresses
invariants: Luby priorities use modulo-2^32 hashing and current-round winners still block lower-priority neighbors
Split hub velocity slots remove their conflicts in Topo; Luby preserves its original graph traversal
Deterministic picks only update pending values; conflict pruning preserves the highest-index winner
Nondeterministic choices must be first-free for a legal observation of each neighbor, not merely an arbitrary valid color
Input fields, fixed colors, sentinel slots and unused dispatch triples are preserved exactly
